# Summer reading programme

The summer reading programme runs for eight weeks from the first Monday after
schools close. Registration opens two weeks before the start and stays open
throughout, so a child joining in week six is not turned away.

A participant records finished titles on a paper log or in the catalogue
account. Six finished titles earns the completion certificate; there is no
requirement that the titles be borrowed from the library, and titles read aloud
by an adult count in full for participants under seven.

Every branch holds one event a week during the programme. Events are not
ticketed and are not capped, except the closing party, which is capped at the
room's fire limit and admits registered participants first.

Fines accrued during the programme on a child card are not written off; child
cards are fine-free year round, so there is nothing to write off.
